subject: fix print for generated quantities command & RStan

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: fix print for generated quantities command & RStan
parts:
I just pushed a fix for the command-line Stan that
enabled prints in the generated quantities block.

Jiqiang -- could you fix it for RStan?

In the command-line code, I had to change

model.write_csv(params_r,params_i,sample_file_stream);

to

model.write_csv(params_r,params_i,sample_file_stream,&std::cout);

in two places (warmup and sampling calls) to pass in a pointer
to the std output stream. The default was to set the print
pointer to 0 and not print.


Assuming this hasn't been done yet, RStan needs to pass a pointer
to the R debug print stream -- the same one that gets fed to the model
for printing.

Here's a simple test model that's not printing now in
the currently released RStan:

--------------------
parameters {
real y;
}
model {
y ~ normal(0,1);
print("model y=",y);
}
generated quantities {
real z;
z <- 2 * y;
print("gq z=",z);
}
-----------------

- Bob
